children.zh-CN: 需要展开或收起的内容。

className.en-US: Class name of the outer wrapper.

collapseHeight.zh-CN: 收起时的高度，单位为像素。大于 0 时收起后仍露出部分内容。
collapseHeight.en-US: Height in pixels when collapsed. When greater than 0, part of the content stays visible.

collapseHeightAdaptive.zh-CN: 内容高度小于 `collapseHeight` 时，收起高度是否取内容高度，即 `Math.min(内容高度, collapseHeight)`。
collapseHeightAdaptive.en-US: Whether the collapsed height follows the content when it is shorter than `collapseHeight`, that is `Math.min(content height, collapseHeight)`.

duration.zh-CN: 动画执行的时间，单位为毫秒。

fade.en-US: Whether to fade in and out.

id.zh-CN: 内层内容元素的 id，可配合触发器的 `aria-controls` 使用。
id.en-US: Id of the inner content element, for the trigger's `aria-controls`.

isOpen.en-US: Whether the content area is expanded.

keepDOM.zh-CN: 是否保留隐藏的内容 DOM 树，默认销毁。
keepDOM.en-US: Whether to keep the DOM tree of the hidden content; it is destroyed by default.

lazyRender.zh-CN: 配合 `keepDOM` 使用，为 `true` 时挂载时不渲染内容，首次展开后才渲染。
lazyRender.en-US: Used with `keepDOM`; when `true`, the content is not rendered on mount but after the first expansion.

onMotionEnd.zh-CN: 展开或收起动画结束时调用。
onMotionEnd.en-US: Called when the expand or collapse animation ends.
